name: Steel MCP
description: Servidor MCP do Steel (/api/mcp): chamadas, erros, latência por ferramenta e clientes OAuth. Troque ['steel'] pelo dataset de NEXT_PUBLIC_AXIOM_DATASET antes de importar.

query.apl:
['steel']
| where message == "mcp.tool_call"
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), outcome = tostring(['fields.outcome'])

['steel']
| where message == "mcp.tool_call"
| where ['fields.outcome'] != "ok"
| summarize errors = count() by tool = tostring(['fields.toolName']), code = tostring(['fields.errorCode']), outcome = tostring(['fields.outcome'])
| order by errors desc
| take 50

['steel']
| where message == "mcp.tool_call"
| summarize calls = count(), p50 = percentile(toreal(['fields.durationMs']), 50), p95 = percentile(toreal(['fields.durationMs']), 95), errors = countif(['fields.outcome'] != "ok") by tool = tostring(['fields.toolName']), kind = tostring(['fields.kind']), module = tostring(['fields.module'])
| where calls >= 3
| order by p95 desc
| take 50

['steel']
| where message == "mcp.tool_call"
| summarize p95 = percentile(toreal(['fields.durationMs']), 95) by bin_auto(_time)

['steel']
| where message == "mcp.tool_call"
| summarize calls = count(), errors = countif(['fields.outcome'] != "ok"), users = dcount(tostring(['fields.userId'])), workspaces = dcount(tostring(['fields.workspaceId'])) by client = tostring(['fields.clientId'])
| order by calls desc
| take 20

['steel']
| where message == "mcp.rejected"
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), reason = tostring(['fields.reason'])

['steel']
| where message == "mcp.rejected" and isnotempty(['fields.clientId'])
| summarize rejected = count() by client = tostring(['fields.clientId']), reason = tostring(['fields.reason'])
| order by rejected desc
| take 20

['steel']
| where message in ("mcp.tool_call", "mcp.handler_failed") and (['fields.outcome'] == "failed" or message == "mcp.handler_failed")
| project _time, message, tool = ['fields.toolName'], client = ['fields.clientId'], workspace = ['fields.workspaceId'], error = ['fields.message']
| order by _time desc
| take 50

['steel']
| where message == "mcp.tools_list"
| summarize listed = avg(toreal(['fields.count'])) by bin_auto(_time)
